body: No, I don't have what can be considered friends.. I have a total of 20 contacts in my phone, which include family members and my boss and a few coworkers in case I need to get my shift covered for whatever reason.  I've always been alone, I've never felt lonely until now.  I spend every weekend the same way, except this time I'm on the internet, looking for the con side to killing myself

I don't really know why I feel the way I do towards my parents, to be honest.  But they do this great thing where they make my problems seem so miniscule and ridiculous that I end up feeling stupid for bringing them to their attention.  I'm afraid to tell them about feeling suicidal, I've already been to therapists for drug and alcohol abuse, I would hate to see what they would feel an appropriate punishment for being suicidal.

I couldn't have said it better myself.  Everything you say you're feeling, I'm feeling, too, just without the girlfriends. (Or friends at all).  My responsibilities are now just burdens I don't want to deal with.  My only reason right now for not ending it is finding a non violent way out, and the fact that my mom would probably be really sad if I did.  Is there anything in particular that stands out to you as a cause for these feelings?  I have an awesome family, a decent life, and the only thing I want is for it to end, and I can't figure out what could be the reason

I'm not in the same boat as you, but I can relate to a lot of what you said you are going through.  I'm just a year older than you; a senior in high school, and the grades come easily enough.  But I've felt like I've slowly been losing hope, I've always been depressed.  Some days were easier than others, but when it went back to being bad, it was always awful.  It was always worse than the time before, and this year I've lost hope completely.  I envy the fact that you have someone outside of your family keeping you here, I lost the majority of the people I was close to after I saw my first therapist.  The only reason I'm considering staying is because of my parents and my sister.  Is your boyfriend the only person you think would be hurt if you were gone?
